parameters.name: numtrials
parameters.description: Total number of trials in the block

parameters.name: gofraction
parameters.description: Proportion of Go trials (150 trials -> 112 Go / 38 No-Go)

parameters.name: maxgorun
parameters.description: Maximum number of Go trials in a row

parameters.name: maxnogorun
parameters.description: Maximum number of No-Go trials in a row

parameters.name: tonedur
parameters.description: Tone duration in ms (must match the .wav files)

parameters.name: jittermin
parameters.description: Minimum response window after the tone (ms)

parameters.name: jittermax
parameters.description: Maximum response window after the tone (ms)

parameters.name: responsemode
parameters.description: Response mode: spacebar (keyboard), leftclick (mouse), touchscreen (touch), clicktarget (click target box), userselect (custom key)
